# Storyclash

> Storyclash is an AI-powered influencer marketing platform that helps brands and agencies discover authentic creators, manage campaigns, and measure ROI across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. The platform uses advanced AI technology to analyze content and match brands with creators who align with their values and aesthetics.

## Core Feature - Creator Discovery
- [AI-Powered Search](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-discovery): Find brand-fit creators based on content analysis rather than vanity metrics
- [Visual Content Matching](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-discovery): Discover creators by describing desired content aesthetics
- [Lookalike Creator Discovery](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-discovery): Find influencers similar to your top-performing creators
- [Advanced Filtering](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-discovery): Filter by country, language, gender, follower size, and engagement rate
- [Brand Collaboration Timeline](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-discovery): View comprehensive history of creator partnerships

## Core Feature - Campaign Management
- [Influencer CRM](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-crm): Manage all creator relationships in one centralized platform
- [Automated Outreach](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-crm): Personalized outreach with templates and automation
- [Campaign Planning](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-crm): Streamline campaign workflow from discovery to execution
- [Content Management](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-crm): Organize and track all campaign content and assets

## Core Feature - Analytics & Reporting
- [Performance Tracking](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-performance-tracking): Monitor campaign performance across 50+ metrics
- [ROI Measurement](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-performance-tracking): Track revenue attribution and discount code performance
- [Cross-Platform Reports](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-performance-tracking): Generate comprehensive reports across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
- [Competitor Analysis](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-performance-tracking): Analyze competitor influencer strategies and collaborations

## Core Feature - Market Insights
- [Competitor Creator Strategy Analysis](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-market-insights): Reverse-engineer any brand's strategy
- [Content Exploration](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-market-insights):  Tap into a brand’s content and performance on every platform.
- [Strategy Analysis](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-market-insights)): Analyze other brands’ influencer strategies
- [Collaboration insights](https://www.storyclash.com/influencer-market-insights)): Get your competitor’s best creators

## Core Feature - Content Intelligence
- [Content Analysis](https://www.storyclash.com/): Analyze creator content for brand alignment and authenticity
- [Hashtag and Mention Tracking](https://www.storyclash.com/): Monitor brand mentions across platforms

## Supported Platforms
- [Instagram Monitoring](https://www.storyclash.com/instagram-monitoring): Track brand mentions and influencers on Instagram
- [TikTok Monitoring](https://www.storyclash.com/tiktok-monitoring): Maximize your TikTok ROI with advanced insights and powerful reporting
- [Facebook Monitoring](https://www.storyclash.com/facebook-monitoring): Monitor brands, influencers and campaigns on Facebook
- [Youtube Monitoring](https://www.storyclash.com/youtube-monitoring): Find content trends and monitor your competition on Youtube
- [Snapchat Monitoring](https://www.storyclash.com/platforms/snapchat-influencer-marketing): Analyse creators and ROI on Snapchat - Coming soon
